title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 57
paragraphs: These are their privileges in war; and in peacetime things have been assigned to them as follows. If any sacrifice is performed at public expense, it is the kings' privilege to sit down to the feast before all others, and for the attendants to begin with them first, and to serve each of them a portion double that given to the other guests; they shall have the first pouring of libations and the hides of the animals slain in sacrifice. On every new moon and seventh day of the month, each of them shall be delivered at public expense a full-grown victim at the temple of Apollo, a measure of barley-groats, and a Laconian quarter of wine; at all the games they shall have seats of honor specially set aside for them. Moreover, it is their privilege to appoint as protectors of strangers (proxenoi) whomever they wish of the citizens, and each to choose two “Pythians” (now the Pythians are men sent to consult the god at Delphi, and they eat with the kings at public expense). If the kings do not come to the public dinner, the rule is that there shall be sent out to their houses two quarts of barley-groats for each and half a pint of wine; but if they are present, they shall be given double shares of everything. They shall be honored in the same way when they have been invited to dinner by private persons. The kings, it is ordained, shall also have charge of the oracles given, but the Pythians too shall have knowledge of them. The rule is moreover that the kings alone give decision on the following cases only: about the maiden who inherits her father's property, namely who ought to have her if her father has not betrothed her to anyone, and about public ways; and if any man wishes to adopt a son, it must be done in the presence of the kings. It is ordained that they shall sit in council with the Senators, who are twenty-eight in number; and if they do not come, those of the Senators most closely related to them shall have the kings' privileges, and give two votes besides their own, making three in all.
